target_moa.text: Long-acting antimuscarinic (anticholinergic) agent that inhibits the M3 receptor on airway smooth muscle leading to bronchodilation

citations.quote: Acldinium bromide is a long-acting antimuscarinic agent, which is often referred to as an anticholinergic.
In the airways, it exhibits pharmacological effects through inhibition of M_3 receptor at the smooth muscle leading to bronchodilation.
Aclidinium bromide is a synthetic, quaternary ammonium compound, chemically described as 1-Azoniabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, 3-[(hydroxydi-2-thienylacetyl)oxy]-1-(3-phenoxypropyl)-, bromide, (3R)-.

description.text: Updated labeling with ASCENT (LAS-MD-45) safety trial results on MACE and reduction in COPD exacerbations, and simplified the indication statement

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application (sNDA) provides for updates to the labeling for Tudorza Pressair (aclidinium bromide) to incorporate results of Study LAS-MD-45 (ASCENT), a post-marketing required safety study, including information regarding major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and reduction in COPD exacerbations. This supplement also provides data for the effect of aclidinium on the St. George's Respiratory Questionnaire (SGRQ) score and labeling updates to comply with the requirements of the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLRR). The indication statement was simplified for consistency with current labeling practices.
